findings.title: Policy Deviation from CLC Guidance - Utility Bill Validity Period

source.text: Policy permits utility bills dated within the last 6 months for address verification

reference.text: a person of that name lives at the address given, for example, by a utility bill less than 3 months old or mortgage statement

findings.deviation: Firm policy permits utility bills up to 6 months old for address verification, but CLC guidance requires utility bills to be less than 3 months old. This is a direct contradiction of regulatory guidance.
